{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Floor-length gown, A-line with a softly structured bodice and a gently defined waist, in deep emerald green (#0F5B45), heavy matte crepe with a subtle satin sheen, with a modest V-neckline and short flutter sleeves to cover the shoulders

Lightweight wrap shawl, hip length, in warm champagne (#E3CDA4), fine chiffon with a silk-like drape, for the evening when it cools after the outdoor ceremony and for the restaurant

Heeled sandals, block heel about 6 cm, closed back strap with a slim ankle strap, in antique gold (#B8924A), smooth nappa leather, comfortable on grass

Clutch, structured envelope shape, in antique gold (#B8924A), matte leather with a fine texture

Drop earrings, medium length, in polished gold (#C9A24D), metal with small pearl details

Thin bangle, in polished gold (#C9A24D), smooth metal

Why this outfit works: The deep emerald crepe gown meets the formal dress code with a classic, restrained line, and its rich color glows against her warm deep skin tone, hair and eyes without being flashy. The A-line shape skims the body and moves easily, while the flutter sleeves and V-neckline keep it elegant and modest for a family wedding. Block-heeled sandals stay stable on an outdoor lawn at 16:00, and the champagne chiffon shawl is a light cover-up that suits an August ceremony and can be removed in the restaurant. Gold accents add polish and keep the whole look cohesive and timeless."}
